About_&_Key_Points:
About
Aqylon Nexus Ltd, formerly Sri Adhikari Brothers Television Network Ltd, emerged from insolvency resolution and changed control in November 2025. The company subsequently changed its name and shifted its focus from television content production and distribution to AI software, IT services and computing infrastructure.

Key Points
** Business Transformation
[1]

⁠The NCLT-approved resolution plan was fully implemented in May 2025, and the CIRP proceedings were closed in September 2025. A subsequent open offer resulted in a change of management and control in November 2025.
The company was renamed Aqylon Nexus Ltd in January 2026 and amended its objects to cover AI/ML software, SaaS, technology consulting, licensing and computing infrastructure.**
